title: Unicycive Therapeutics (UNCY) Is Down 33.1% After FDA CRL Cites Third-Party Manufacturing Deficiencies
summary: In late June 2026, Unicycive Therapeutics received a Complete Response Letter from the FDA on its resubmitted oxylanthanum carbonate NDA, citing unresolved third-party manufacturing deficiencies while raising no new clinical efficacy or safety concerns and requesting no additional data.
